# Routledge

> Routledge is a leading global academic and professional book publisher offering peer-reviewed research, textbooks, and curated collections across STEM, humanities, and social sciences.

As part of the Taylor & Francis Group, Routledge publishes thousands of titles including the prestigious Routledge Classics series and specialized collections like The Psychology of Everything. The platform serves academic institutions, instructors, authors, and researchers worldwide with comprehensive catalog browsing, author publishing services, and educational resources.

- Peer-Reviewed Research

## Browse & Discover

- [Subjects - Books in STEM, Humanities, and Social Sciences](https://www.routledge.com/subjects): Subject category browsing for STEM, humanities, and social sciences
- [New and Bestselling Titles](https://www.routledge.com/new-and-bestselling-books): New releases and bestsellers including Psychology and Classics series
- [Featured Books - Book Lists](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists): Curated book lists featuring Routledge Classics and Psychology series
- [Routledge Classics - Celebrating 25 Years](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists/routledge-classics): Routledge Classics series celebrating 25 years with featured authors
- [Routledge Companions - Book Series](https://www.routledge.com/Routledge-Companions/book-series/ROUTCOMPS): Routledge Companions scholarly reference book series
